concepts.gloss_en: holy utterances/words (plural, indefinite) — distinct number and definiteness from singular form; different Torah context

notes: Singular definite (דבור הקדוש, lm2:15) vs plural indefinite (דבורים קדושים, lm1:63). Different number and definiteness, different Torahs; proofs do not establish shared referent. Kept separate per under-merge rule. Note דבורים could conceivably read as 'bees' given the nature imagery (נחש ונמלה) in lm1:63, adding further uncertainty against merging.
